title: typos-format telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the typos-format hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "typos-format". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the checked file, relative to the consuming repo root.

applied.description: Corrections this run wrote into the file. Empty array = nothing was modified (clean, or the hook is in report-only mode).

typo.description: The token as it appeared before the rewrite.

correction.description: The token it was rewritten to.

line.description: 1-based line number of the rewritten token, as reported before the write.

findings.description: typos findings the run did NOT apply — no known correction, more than one candidate correction, or report-only mode. Empty array = clean or fully fixed.

corrections.description: Known correction candidates, or null when the term is disallowed with no known correction.
